name: B10-0126/2026 (The Left) – World Cancer Day
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on World Cancer Day
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its position for World Cancer Day. It asks the European Union and member states to keep funding and running Europe's Beating Cancer Plan, to give health its own budget, to improve cancer screening, prevention and treatment across borders, and to protect cancer survivors from financial discrimination, such as being refused loans or insurance because of their medical history.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a statement of the Parliament's demands, not a new law.
- **Who it affects:** Cancer patients, survivors, families, health workers and researchers across the European Union.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, the Commission and member state governments, which decide whether to act on it.
